frozen_snapshot.english_definition: An opinion or explanation based on incomplete evidence.
frozen_snapshot.burmese_meaning: အထောက်အထား မပြည့်စုံသေးချိန်တွင် ခန့်မှန်းထားသော အယူအဆ
frozen_snapshot.example_sentence: Without test results, the cause of the failure remains conjecture.

publisher_observation.source_sense_summary: Oxford separates countable speculative opinion from uncountable activity of guessing; 'remains conjecture' is awkward for the frozen countable opinion. Topic Opinion and argument c2 is NOT an exact-sense C2 label.

frozen_snapshot.english_definition: A lack of agreement between ideas, values or feelings.
frozen_snapshot.burmese_meaning: အယူအဆများ၊ တန်ဖိုးထားမှုများ သို့မဟုတ် ခံစားချက်များအကြား မညီညွတ်မှု
frozen_snapshot.example_sentence: She felt dissonance between her values and the company's actions.

publisher_observation.source_sense_summary: Oxford distinguishes musical discord (countable/uncountable) from formal disagreement (uncountable); frozen example uses formal disagreement and 'felt dissonance' is less idiomatic than 'the dissonance between'.
